title: समकालीन नेपाली कविताको संस्कृतिपरक अन्तर्विषयकता {Cultural Intersubjectivity of Contemporary Nepali Poetry}
nepali: प्रस्तुत अनुसन्धानात्मक लेख समकालीन नेपाली कविताको संस्कृतिपरक अन्तविर्षयकताको अध्ययनमा केन्द्रित भएर तयार पारिएको हो । यसरी अध्ययन गर्ने क्रममा समकालीन नेपाली कविताका रूपमा पछिल्लो समय प्रकाशित कवितासङ्ग्रहमा सङ्गृहीत प्रतिनिधिमूलक कवितालाई अध्ययनको आधार बनाइएको छ । नेपाली साहित्यका अन्य विधामा जस्तै समकालीन नेपाली कवितामा पनि अन्तर्विषयकताको प्रयोग भएको छ । साहित्यको विषयवस्तुभित्र साहित्येतर विषयहरू अन्तर्वस्तुका रूपमा प्रयोग हुनुलाई अन्तर्विषयकता भनिन्छ । विश्वसाहित्यमा सन्१९६० पछि उत्तरआधुनिक बहुलवादी सिद्धान्त र सांस्कृतिक अध्ययनको विकासका क्रममा अन्तर्विषयक समालोचनाको विकास भएको हो । साहित्यमा अन्तर्विषयकताको प्रयोग हुन थालेपछि यसप्रकारको साहित्यको अध्ययन–विश्लेषण गर्नका लागि अन्तर्विषयक समालोचनाको आरम्भ भएको हो । समकालीन नेपाली कवितामा संस्कृतिपरक अन्तर्विषयकताको प्रयोग केकसरी भएको छ ? भन्ने प्राज्ञिक जिज्ञासा समाधान गर्ने उद्देश्यले तयार पारिएको यस अनुसन्धानलेखमा संस्कृतिपरक अन्तर्विषयकताका अवधारणाको उपयोग गरिएको छ । समकालीन नेपाली कवितामा संस्कृतिपरक अन्तर्विषयकताका विभिन्न पक्षहरुको प्रयोग भए पनि यस अनुसन्धानात्मक आलेखमा परम्परागत संस्कृति, निर्मित संस्कृति र जातीय संस्कृति गरी संस्कृतिका तीनवटा पक्षलाई मात्र विश्लेषणको आधार बनाइएको छ । समकालीन नेपाली कवितामा संस्कृतिपरक अन्तर्विषयकता प्रभावकारी रूपमा आएको र यसले कवितालाई बहुआयामिक, बौद्धिक, गहन र स्तरीय बनाएको निष्कर्ष यस अनुसन्धानात्मक लेखमा निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: The present research article has been prepared with a focus on the study of the cultural intersubjectivity of contemporary Nepali poetry. In the course of studying in this way, representative poems gathered in poetry collections published in recent times were made the basis of the study as contemporary Nepali poetry. As in other genres of Nepali literature, intersubjectivity has been used in contemporary Nepali poetry as well. The use of non-literary subjects as content within the subject matter of literature is called intersubjectivity. In world literature, intersubjective criticism developed after 1960 in the course of the growth of postmodern pluralist theory and cultural studies. Once intersubjectivity began to be used in literature, intersubjective criticism was started in order to study and analyze literature of this kind. This research article, prepared with the aim of resolving the academic question of how cultural intersubjectivity has been used in contemporary Nepali poetry, employs the concept of cultural intersubjectivity. Although various aspects of cultural intersubjectivity have been used in contemporary Nepali poetry, only three aspects of culture — traditional culture, constructed culture and ethnic culture — have been made the basis of analysis in this research article. The conclusion drawn in this research article is that cultural intersubjectivity has come into contemporary Nepali poetry effectively and that this has made the poetry multidimensional, intellectual, profound and of a high standard.
british_english: The present research paper has been written with its focus upon a study of the cultural intersubjectivity of contemporary Nepali poetry. In the course of carrying out that study, representative poems collected in recently published poetry anthologies were taken as the basis of the study in the character of contemporary Nepali poetry. Just as in other genres of Nepali literature, so too in contemporary Nepali poetry has intersubjectivity been employed. The employment of non-literary subjects as content within the subject matter of literature is termed intersubjectivity. In world literature, intersubjective criticism arose after 1960 in the course of the development of postmodern pluralist theory and of cultural studies. Once intersubjectivity came to be employed in literature, intersubjective criticism was embarked upon in order to study and analyse literature of this sort. This research paper, written with the object of settling the academic question of how cultural intersubjectivity has been employed in contemporary Nepali poetry, makes use of the concept of cultural intersubjectivity. Although a variety of aspects of cultural intersubjectivity have been employed in contemporary Nepali poetry, only three aspects of culture — traditional culture, constructed culture and ethnic culture — have been taken as the basis of analysis in this research paper. The conclusion reached in this research paper is that cultural intersubjectivity has come into contemporary Nepali poetry to good effect and that this has rendered the poetry many-sided, intellectual, searching and of a high calibre.
australian_english: This research article has been put together around a study of the cultural intersubjectivity of contemporary Nepali poetry. While doing the study, representative poems gathered in poetry collections put out lately were used as the basis of the study as contemporary Nepali poetry. Just like in other genres of Nepali literature, intersubjectivity has turned up in contemporary Nepali poetry too. Using non-literary subjects as content inside the subject matter of literature is what's called intersubjectivity. In world literature, intersubjective criticism got going after 1960 as postmodern pluralist theory and cultural studies developed. Once intersubjectivity started getting used in literature, intersubjective criticism kicked off so that literature of this kind could be studied and analysed. This research article, put together with the aim of sorting out the academic question of how cultural intersubjectivity has been used in contemporary Nepali poetry, draws on the concept of cultural intersubjectivity. Even though all sorts of aspects of cultural intersubjectivity have been used in contemporary Nepali poetry, only three aspects of culture — traditional culture, constructed culture and ethnic culture — have been made the basis for analysis in this research article. The conclusion this research article draws is that cultural intersubjectivity has come through strongly in contemporary Nepali poetry and that it has made the poetry many-sided, intellectual, deep and top-notch.
informal_english: This research paper is all about looking into the cultural intersubjectivity you find in contemporary Nepali poetry. While doing that, I took the representative poems collected in recently published poetry collections as my base for studying contemporary Nepali poetry. Intersubjectivity turns up in contemporary Nepali poetry just as it does in the other genres of Nepali literature. When you bring non-literary subjects in as content inside what a piece of literature is about, that's what people call intersubjectivity. Over in world literature, intersubjective criticism got going after 1960, along with the rise of postmodern pluralist theory and cultural studies. Once people started using intersubjectivity in literature, they got intersubjective criticism going so they could study and analyse that sort of literature. This paper was written to sort out the academic question of just how cultural intersubjectivity gets used in contemporary Nepali poetry, and for that it uses the idea of cultural intersubjectivity. There are all sorts of sides to cultural intersubjectivity in contemporary Nepali poetry, but this paper only takes three sides of culture — traditional culture, constructed culture and ethnic culture — as its base for analysis. The paper concludes that cultural intersubjectivity has come through properly in contemporary Nepali poetry, and that it's made the poetry many-sided, brainy, deep and properly good.
translator_notes: अन्तर्विषयकता is rendered 'intersubjectivity'; the source spelling alternates between अन्तर्विषयकता and अन्तविर्षयकता (typo), both treated as the same term. Sentence order follows the source exactly.
